components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[-0-9 ()]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The display name of the pet owner, formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The initials of the pet owner, formatted as the upper-cased first letters of the first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            registrationDate:
              title: Registration date
              description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to the current date when not supplied.
              type: string
              format: date
              example: '2020-01-01'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The sequential membership number assigned to the pet owner on creation, equal to one more than the number of owners that existed beforehand.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The customer code assigned to the pet owner on creation, formatted as '<UPPERCASE_CITY>-<NNNN>' where NNNN is one more than the number of owners that existed in that city beforehand, zero-padded to four digits.
              type: string
              example: 'LONDON-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipTier:
              title: Membership tier
              description: The membership tier assigned to the pet owner on creation. The first 100 owners ever created are 'FOUNDING'; all later owners are 'STANDARD'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - FOUNDING
                - STANDARD
              example: FOUNDING
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of other owners that shared the pet owner's last name at the moment the pet owner was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 0
              readOnly: true
            sharesHousehold:
              title: Shares household
              description: Whether another owner already had the same address and city at the moment this pet owner was created.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:

## Summary

I implemented the `locality` field for owner creation. When an owner is created, the response now includes `locality` set to `local` if their city is the single most common city among existing owners at that moment, otherwise `remote`.

Changes made:

1. **`openapi.yml`** — Added a read-only `locality` property (enum `local`/`remote`) to the `Owner` schema, matching the style of the existing computed fields.

2. **`model/Owner.java`** — Added a `locality` field (`@Column(name = "locality")`) with getter/setter.

3. **`db/{hsqldb,h2,mysql,postgres}/schema.sql`** — Added the `locality` column to the `owners` table in each dialect (tests run on hsqldb).

4. **`controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** — In `addOwner`, added `owner.setLocality(determineLocality(owner.getCity()))` and a `determineLocality` helper. It builds a case-insensitive frequency map of existing owners' cities, finds the max count, and returns `LOCAL` only when there is exactly one city at that max count and it equals the new owner's city; otherwise `REMOTE` (also for null/no-owner/tie cases).

Note on a subtlety I hit: the generated MapStruct mapper converts the model string to the DTO enum via `Enum.valueOf(class, name)`, which requires the enum **name** (`LOCAL`/`REMOTE`), while the JSON output uses the enum's lowercase `@JsonValue` (`local`/`remote`). So the model stores the uppercase name — exactly like the existing `membershipTier` field — and the serialized response is the lowercase `local`/`remote` the spec requires.
